description: Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul researchers publish seven years of hybrid-energy-system simulation results generated with HOMER Legacy. The 2020 Mendeley release links twelve associated studies and describes combinations of energy availability, consumer loads, component specifications, optimisation variables and sensitivity assumptions. Simulations cover one operating year with techno-economic comparisons commonly spanning twenty to twenty-five years, ranked by net present cost. Version 2 is freely available under CC BY 4.0. These study-specific files can benchmark hybrid-power planning or support teaching across the documented cases. File extensions and current compatibility were not inspected. The related platform-homer-hybrid-power-modeling describes the contemporary commercial software family, whose behaviour need not match Legacy.
name: Seven years simulating hybrid energy systems with Homer Legacy
